data.one_liner: Provides 14k+ additional icons across multiple icon sets for Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: Bundles multiple popular icon sets (like AntDesign, FontAwesome, Ionicons, MaterialCommunityIcons, and others) into a single Flutter package. Exposes icons directly via individual classes or through the unified `FlutterIcons` class, and includes an `IconToggle` widget.
use_when: You need a wide variety of icon sets beyond the standard Flutter Material icons
You want access to popular icon families like FontAwesome, Ionicons, or Octicons within a single dependency
avoid_when: You only need standard Material icons already included in Flutter
You want to minimize app binary size and want a more targeted icon package
strengths: Huge collection of over 14,000 icons from dozens of popular icon sets
Includes a utility tool to split and keep only the fonts used in the project
weaknesses: Can significantly increase app size if unused icon fonts are not stripped out
Migrated to standalone `package:material_ui` in version 1.0.0 which may require compatibility handling for standard apps
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and optionally run split_icon to reduce app size by keeping only used font sets.

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need FontAwesome icons instead of a massive multi-family package.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the clean Lucide icon set.
